# S25 — TUI actions: launch, approve and stop

Owner wants ork to be the one app that runs relays (2026-10-20). Today the TUI is display only (S22); approve, stop and retry are CLI only. Decided: #98 ui.confirm (stop confirms; approve runs on one key) and #107 ui.launch-split (S25 is approve, stop and retry; launch is S52). ork retry comes from S44. The Overview already has a row cursor (internal/tui/model.go cursor, overview.go rows).

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

The Overview shows what needs the owner but cannot act on it. Approve, stop and retry are the three actions a Needs-you or Running engine row needs; launch needs a list surface and is S52.

## Files

- internal/tui: keys.go (bindings and help), model.go (key handling, a pending-confirm state), overview.go (the cursor row's engine run ID and state), view.go (the confirm bar), live.go and daemon.go (action calls beside Refresh, Focus, Next), tests, goldens.
- internal/daemon/client.go: typed approve, stop and retry calls over Call (the CLI uses Call today).
- docs/dashboard.md: the action keys (line ~120 says they are not implemented).
- Key letters are proposed: a approve, x stop, t retry (r, s, n, p, q are taken).

## Failing tests

- A key on the cursor's engine row approves an awaiting-approval run with no confirmation (ui.confirm #98); on any other state it does nothing and says why.
- Retry on a paused run that has no question shows the exact command (ork retry RUN) and asks y/n (Enter is No) before running it; on a run with a question it does nothing and says to answer.
- Stop shows the exact command (ork stop RUN) and asks y/n (Enter is No) before running it.
- A failed call shows its error code and message verbatim.
- Runs started elsewhere (ledger rows with no engine run) offer no actions (dash.external-runs).
- The row updates after a call that worked.
- The help view lists the new keys.
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.
- docs/dashboard.md no longer says the action keys are not implemented.
